name: 415 · RFC Guard · SU01 synthetic contract test

parameters.content:
## SU01 contract test — synthetic data

This workflow tests the node contract only. It does **not** call SAP or RFC.

1. Select the dedicated synthetic contract credential.
2. Click **Execute workflow**.
3. Confirm that six fictitious users are returned.
4. Check **_rfc.readOnly = true** and **_rfc.source = contract-fixture**.

Deny-by-default check: temporarily change **Business Operation ID** to **createPurchaseOrder**. The node must reject it. Restore **listSu01Users** afterwards.

Keep this workflow unpublished.
